gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-chocolate-classica: Chocolate Classical Sans keeps a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut. Coming Soon is the loose, handwritten voice, good at sounding personal in a few big words, while the plain sans body does the steady work of carrying text with its sizable lowercase.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-comme: Loose handwriting meets a smooth modern read. Coming Soon draws casual, pen-and-paper letters with a constant line width, and Comme follows with lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height and no clogged curves.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-cossette-texte: Scrawled charm over tidy text. Coming Soon is best at sounding casual and personal, with lowercase rising close to capitals, whereas Cossette Texte is best at staying out of the way with a prominent x-height and a plain sans build.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-duru-sans: Every stroke in Coming Soon keeps one steady width, with no contrast between stems and joins, like a quick pen note. And Duru Sans, a modern sans-serif with wide openings on small letters, gives that looseness a tidy, clean footing.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-epunda-slab: Scribbled warmth, then slab dignity. The shared quality here is the clash between Coming Soon's casual, fixed-nib handwriting and Epunda Slab, a serif with tall rounded lowercase and a visibly gaping c.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-fauna-one: Every stroke in Coming Soon is cut to one width, which gives it a casual, personal hand. Fauna One then settles into a literary pace, its tall middle band and shallow ascenders making a longer passage feel dignified and unhurried.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-fresca: Casual, personal, a bit scribbled: that is Coming Soon at the top. Fresca takes over for the real reading, a plain sans whose connected counters and short ascenders above big bowls do the clean, modern work the handwriting leaves alone.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-funnel-sans: Coming Soon writes like a quick note, with lowercase climbing close to capitals. Funnel Sans is the one to lean on for clean, professional text, a plain sans with stroke widths that hold steady and a wide-open e.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-gafata: Gafata is a sans-serif with a tall band of letters, short stalks above and wide-eyed lowercase e shapes. Coming Soon earns its keep in big, short phrases, where its one-thickness pen-and-paper outlines feel casual and personal.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-geist: Handwritten ease on top, a quiet level sans beneath, with no accents of weight anywhere in the body. Geist reads in solid word blocks rather than skylines, so a long passage would move smoothly.
